application.name: Al Manaratain Quality Control
application.note: This is not a standalone index.html website. It requires a Node.js API, PostgreSQL, object storage, and same-origin /api routing.

database.warning: Run the schema command against the intended database before starting the API. Do not use a development database URL for production.

objectStorage.purpose: Complaint pictures, archive documents, and other uploaded files

requiredEnvironmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_OBJECT_SEARCH_PATHS
requiredEnvironmentVariables.description: Comma-separated public object-storage paths used by the API

requiredEnvironmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_OBJECT_DIR
requiredEnvironmentVariables.description: Private object-storage directory used by the API

objectStorage.providerNote: If using a provider other than Replit Object Storage, configure that provider's credentials and map its public/private locations to these application variables.

apiRequired.name: PORT
apiRequired.description: Port used by the API process

apiOptional.name: ARCHIVE_MANAGER_EMAILS
apiOptional.description: Comma-separated email allowlist for archive retirement

apiOptional.name: ARCHIVE_MANAGER_EMPLOYEE_IDS
apiOptional.description: Comma-separated registered employee ID allowlist for archive retirement

apiOptional.name: QC_ADMIN_EMPLOYEE_IDS
apiOptional.description: Comma-separated registered employee ID allowlist for QC employee administration

providerSpecific.name: DEFAULT_OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET_ID
providerSpecific.description: Replit Object Storage identifier. Use the equivalent bucket/project setting when deploying to another provider.

providerSpecific.name: SESSION_SECRET
providerSpecific.description: Keep available if the selected hosting/authentication adapter requires it. The current employee session implementation stores sessions in PostgreSQL.

api.singleDomainMode: The API process also serves the built frontend when SERVE_FRONTEND=true.

singleDomainWebsite.description: One normal website URL serves the React frontend and the Express API behind /api.

routing.spaFallback: Unknown non-API GET routes return the frontend index.html

routing.frontend: Serve artifacts/al-manaratain-qc/dist/public for all non-API routes
routing.api: Proxy /api/* to the Node API process on port 8080
routing.cookies: Keep frontend and API on the same site/domain so employee session cookies work

staticHostOnly.warning: A static-only deployment will show the interface but login, records, reports, uploads, and database operations will not work without a separately hosted API and /api proxy.

cloudflarePages.deploymentCommand: npx wrangler pages deploy artifacts/al-manaratain-qc/dist/public --project-name almanaratain-qc-website
cloudflarePages.warning: Use Cloudflare Pages for the frontend only. Do not run the Express API with pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start on Cloudflare Pages.
